goal: Prevent wallet nodes from leaking their IP addresses by no longer rebroadcasting incoming transactions
Stop observers from linking addresses to nodes by sending low-fee probe transactions
agreement: Concept approval if the behavior is made configurable (vasild)
Unaddressed objection: rebroadcast aids confirmation and mempool presence is needed for CPFP (achow101)
Unaddressed objection: wallet CPFP children fail to reload or rebroadcast after restart or expiry (fametrano)

categories.name: wallet
why: P1 because it fixes a decade-old privacy leak linking wallet ownership to node IP addresses
Attackers can probe any address with a low-fee transaction and observe which node rebroadcasts it
